addSubmission(string,string).details: Make a request to add a new entry to the list. Paying the full deposit right away is not required as it can be crowdfunded later.

params._evidence: A link to evidence using its URI.
params._name: The name of the submitter. This parameter is for Subgraph only and it won't be used in this function.

addSubmissionManually(address[],string[].details: Allows the governor to directly add new submissions to the list as a part of the seeding event.

params._evidence: The array of evidence links for each submission.
params._names: The array of names of the submitters. This parameter is for Subgraph only and it won't be used in this function.
params._submissionIDs: The addresses of newly added submissions.

addVouch(address).details: Vouch for the submission. Note that the event spam is not an issue as it will be handled by the UI.

params._submissionID: The address of the submission to vouch for.

challengeRequest(address,uint8,address,s.details: Challenge the submission's request. Accepts enough ETH to cover the deposit, reimburses the rest.

params._duplicateID: The address of a supposed duplicate submission. Ignored if the reason is not Duplicate.
params._evidence: A link to evidence using its URI. Ignored if not provided.
params._reason: The reason to challenge the request. Left empty for removal requests.
params._submissionID: The address of the submission which request to challenge.

changeArbitrator(address,bytes).details: Change the arbitrator to be used for disputes that may be raised in the next requests. The arbitrator is trusted to support appeal period and not reenter.

params._arbitrator: The new trusted arbitrator to be used in the next requests.
params._arbitratorExtraData: The extra data used by the new arbitrator.

changeDurations(uint64,uint64,uint64).details: Change the duration of the submission, renewal and challenge periods.

params._challengePeriodDuration: The new duration of the challenge period. It should be lower than the time for a dispute.
params._renewalPeriodDuration: The new value that defines the duration of submission's renewal period.
params._submissionDuration: The new duration of the time the submission is considered registered.

changeGovernor(address).details: Change the governor of the contract.

params._governor: The address of the new governor.

changeLoserStakeMultiplier(uint256).details: Change the proportion of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake by the party that lost the previous round.

params._loserStakeMultiplier: Multiplier of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake. In basis points.

changeMetaEvidence(string,string).details: Update the meta evidence used for disputes.

params._clearingMetaEvidence: The meta evidence to be used for future clearing request disputes.
params._registrationMetaEvidence: The meta evidence to be used for future registration request disputes.

changeRequiredNumberOfVouches(uint64).details: Change the number of vouches required for the request to pass to the pending state.

params._requiredNumberOfVouches: The new required number of vouches.

changeSharedStakeMultiplier(uint256).details: Change the proportion of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake by parties when there is no winner or loser (e.g. when the arbitrator refused to rule).

params._sharedStakeMultiplier: Multiplier of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake. In basis points.

changeStateToPending(address,address[],b.details: Change submission's state from Vouching to PendingRegistration if all conditions are met.

params._expirationTimestamps: Array of expiration timestamps for each signature (optional). struct IsHumanVoucher {     address vouchedSubmission;     uint256 voucherExpirationTimestamp; }
params._signatures: Array of EIP-712 signatures of struct IsHumanVoucher (optional).
params._submissionID: The address of the submission which status to change.
params._vouches: Array of users whose vouches to count.

changeSubmissionBaseDeposit(uint256).details: Change the base amount required as a deposit to make a request for a submission.

params._submissionBaseDeposit: The new base amount of wei required to make a new request.

changeWinnerStakeMultiplier(uint256).details: Change the proportion of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake by the winner of the previous round.

params._winnerStakeMultiplier: Multiplier of arbitration fees that must be paid as fee stake. In basis points.

checkRequestDuplicates(address,uint256,a.details: Checks whether the duplicate address has been used in challenging the request or not.

params._submissionID: The address of the submission to check.

checkRequestDuplicates(address,uint256,a.return: Whether the duplicate has been used.

params._arbitrator: The trusted arbitrator to resolve potential disputes.
params._arbitratorExtraData: Extra data for the trusted arbitrator contract.
params._challengePeriodDuration: The time in seconds during which the request can be challenged.
params._clearingMetaEvidence: The URI of the meta evidence object for clearing requests.
params._multipliers: The array that contains fee stake multipliers to avoid 'stack too deep' error.
params._registrationMetaEvidence: The URI of the meta evidence object for registration requests.
params._renewalPeriodDuration: Value that defines the duration of submission's renewal period.
params._requiredNumberOfVouches: The number of vouches the submission has to have to pass from Vouching to PendingRegistration state.
params._submissionBaseDeposit: The base deposit to make a request for a submission.
params._submissionDuration: Time in seconds during which the registered submission won't automatically lose its status.

executeRequest(address).details: Execute a request if the challenge period passed and no one challenged the request.

params._submissionID: The address of the submission with the request to execute.

fundAppeal(address,uint256,uint8).details: Takes up to the total amount required to fund a side of an appeal. Reimburses the rest. Creates an appeal if both sides are fully funded.

params._challengeID: The index of a dispute, created for the request.
params._submissionID: The address of the submission which request to fund.

fundSubmission(address).details: Fund the requester's deposit. Accepts enough ETH to cover the deposit, reimburses the rest.

params._submissionID: The address of the submission which ongoing request to fund.

getArbitratorDataListCount().details: Gets the number of times the arbitrator data was updated.
getArbitratorDataListCount().return: The number of arbitrator data updates.

getChallengeInfo(address,uint256,uint256.details: Gets the information of a particular challenge of the request.

params._submissionID: The address of the queried submission.

getContributions(address,uint256,uint256.details: Gets the contributions made by a party for a given round of a given challenge of a request.

params._submissionID: The address of the submission.

getNumberOfVouches(address,uint256).details: Gets the number of vouches of a particular request.

params._submissionID: The address of the queried submission.

getRequestInfo(address,uint256).details: Gets information of a request of a submission.

params._submissionID: The address of the queried submission.

getRoundInfo(address,uint256,uint256,uin.details: Gets the information of a round of a request.

params._submissionID: The address of the queried submission.

getSubmissionInfo(address).details: Returns the information of the submission. Includes length of requests array.

params._submissionID: The address of the queried submission.

isRegistered(address).details: Returns true if the submission is registered and not expired.

params._submissionID: The address of the submission.

isRegistered(address).return: Whether the submission is registered or not.

processVouches(address,uint256,uint256).details: Processes vouches of the resolved request, so vouchings of users who vouched for it can be used in other submissions. Penalizes users who vouched for bad submissions.

params._iterations: The number of iterations to go through.
params._requestID: The ID of the request which vouches to iterate.
params._submissionID: The address of the submission which vouches to iterate.

reapplySubmission(string,string).details: Make a request to refresh a submissionDuration. Paying the full deposit right away is not required as it can be crowdfunded later. Note that the user can reapply even when current submissionDuration has not expired, but only after the start of renewal period.

params._evidence: A link to evidence using its URI.
params._name: The name of the submitter. This parameter is for Subgraph only and it won't be used in this function.

removeSubmission(address,string).details: Make a request to remove a submission from the list. Requires full deposit. Accepts enough ETH to cover the deposit, reimburses the rest. Note that this request can't be made during the renewal period to avoid spam leading to submission's expiration.

params._evidence: A link to evidence using its URI.
params._submissionID: The address of the submission to remove.

removeSubmissionManually(address).details: Allows the governor to directly remove a registered entry from the list as a part of the seeding event.

params._submissionID: The address of a submission to remove.

removeVouch(address).details: Remove the submission's vouch that has been added earlier. Note that the event spam is not an issue as it will be handled by the UI.

params._submissionID: The address of the submission to remove vouch from.

rule(uint256,uint256).details: Give a ruling for a dispute. Can only be called by the arbitrator. TRUSTED. Accounts for the situation where the winner loses a case due to paying less appeal fees than expected.

params._disputeID: ID of the dispute in the arbitrator contract.
params._ruling: Ruling given by the arbitrator. Note that 0 is reserved for "Refused to arbitrate".

submitEvidence(address,string).details: Submit a reference to evidence. EVENT.

params._evidence: A link to an evidence using its URI.
params._submissionID: The address of the submission which the evidence is related to.

withdrawFeesAndRewards(address,address,u.details: Reimburses contributions if no disputes were raised. If a dispute was raised, sends the fee stake rewards and reimbursements proportionally to the contributions made to the winner of a dispute.

params._beneficiary: The address that made contributions to a request.
params._challengeID: The ID of the challenge from which to withdraw.
params._requestID: The request from which to withdraw.
params._round: The round from which to withdraw.
params._submissionID: The address of the submission with the request from which to withdraw.

withdrawSubmission().details: Allows to withdraw a mistakenly added submission while it's still in a vouching state.

devdoc.title: ProofOfHumanity This contract is a curated registry for people. The users are identified by their address and can be added or removed through the request-challenge protocol. In order to challenge a registration request the challenger must provide one of the four reasons. New registration requests firstly should gain sufficient amount of vouches from other registered users and only after that they can be accepted or challenged. The users who vouched for submission that lost the challenge with the reason Duplicate or DoesNotExist would be penalized with optional fine or ban period. NOTE: This contract trusts that the Arbitrator is honest and will not reenter or modify its costs during a call. The arbitrator must support appeal period.
